description: The quorum boundary at the standard 15-node shape. With 7 bp the quorum is floor(2n/3)+1 = 5, so five producing must be enough and four must not. The case stops two (leaving exactly five) and requires production to continue, stops a third and requires it to halt, then restarts all three and requires it to resume -- so each half proves the other is not a coincidence. The four-node case (consensus/02) checks the same rule where the numbers are small; this one checks it where eight of the fifteen nodes are not validators at all and the endpoints reach the producers through a pn.
